info.syllabusName: 3D Modeling & Texturing (Maya) Xây dựng mô hình và tạo chất liệu trong môi trường 3D
info.description:
This course will prepare you:

This course covers the fundamentals of working in CG (Computer Graphic) with Maya. It’s only a starting point, though. As with any artistic pursuit, CG is a lifelong process of learning. With what you learn in this course forming a solid foundation, you can continue exploring all the complex, interesting facets of creating CG imagery

Teaching methods:

- Student is the center, practice combined with theory

- Help students have a self-study method

- Presentation method combined with group working method

- Teachers are instructors, organizing activities

- The result is a combination of teacher and student evaluation
